title: Aunty's Tough Love Monday
script: Aunty Sisi Lola dey tell you today: That podcast idea? Record episode one this week. That Ankara brand? Post your first 3 mockups. That AI project? Test it, fail small, adjust, move. New Africa no dey wait for permission – we create first, refine later. Perfectionism na colonial pressure o! Post it, my dear. The algorithm go reward consistency over perfection!
caption:
Aunty Sisi Lola dey tell you: POST IT! 📱✨

That idea in your head? It's useless until you share it.

Perfectionism na colonial pressure – New Africa creators dey move!

What you dey procrastinate on? Drop am below, make we hold you accountable! 👇🏾
